(#{it.minePlanId},#{it.monthPlan}, #{it.dayPlan}, #{it.monthTarget}, #{it.dayTarget}, #{it.unitName}, #{it.unitCode}, #{it.isDeleted})
mapper.update: UPDATE sub_mine_plan SET is_deleted = #{isDeleted} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE sub_mine_plan SET is_deleted = #{isDeleted},month_plan=0,day_plan=0,month_target=0,day_target=0 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE sub_mine_plan SET day_plan= #{isDeleted},day_target= #{isDeleted} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sub_mine_plan WHERE mine_plan_id = #{planId} ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT * FROM sub_mine_plan WHERE id = #{id} ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT * FROM sub_mine_plan WHERE mine_plan_id IN #{pid} ORDER BY mine_plan_id ASC, id ASC

SELECT t2.unit_name,t2.unit_code, sum(t2.month_plan) as month_plan, sum(t2.month_target) as month_target FROM sub_mine_plan t2 INNER JOIN mine_plan t1 ON t1.id = t2.mine_plan_id WHERE YEAR(t1.plan_month) = YEAR(#{statsDate}) and t1.mine_category='全矿' AND t1.plan_type = #{planType} AND t1.plan_month <= #{statsDate} and t2.is_deleted=0 GROUP BY t2.unit_name,t2.unit_code

SELECT t2.unit_name,t2.unit_code, sum(t2.month_plan) as month_plan, sum(t2.month_target) as month_target FROM sub_mine_plan t2 INNER JOIN mine_plan t1 ON t1.id = t2.mine_plan_id WHERE YEAR(t1.plan_month) = YEAR(#{statsDate}) and t1.mine_category='单矿' and t1.unit_name=#{unitName} AND t1.plan_type = #{planType} AND t1.plan_month <= #{statsDate} and t2.is_deleted=0 GROUP BY t2.unit_name,t2.unit_code

SELECT t2.unit_name,t2.unit_code, sum(t2.month_plan) as month_plan, sum(t2.month_target) as month_target FROM sub_mine_plan t2 INNER JOIN mine_plan t1 ON t1.id = t2.mine_plan_id WHERE YEAR(t1.plan_month) = YEAR(#{statsDate}) AND MONTH(t1.plan_month) = MONTH(#{statsDate}) and t1.mine_category='全矿' AND t1.plan_type = #{planType} AND t1.plan_month <= #{statsDate} GROUP BY t2.unit_name,t2.unit_code

SELECT sum(day_plan) as day_plan,sum(month_plan) as month_plan, sum(day_target) as day_target ,sum(month_target) as month_target from sub_mine_plan t1 left join mine_plan t2 on t2.id =t1.mine_plan_id where t2.plan_type= #{planType} and t2.mine_category= #{mineCategory} and plan_month=#{planMonth} and t1.is_deleted=0

SELECT sum(month_plan) as year_plan, sum(month_target) as year_target from sub_mine_plan t1 left join mine_plan t2 on t2.id =t1.mine_plan_id where t2.plan_type= #{planType} and t2.mine_category= #{mineCategory} and year(plan_month)=year(#{planMonth}) and t1.is_deleted=0
